# Portfolio website

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `README.md`. This is React 18 + Vite with build-time static HTML on GitHub Pages. Project content lives in `src/content/`, routes are generated by `scripts/prerender.mjs`, and normal anchors navigate between documents.

Read affected code and recent changes before editing. Run `npm run check` and `npm run test:e2e` after changes, and report material behavior changes. Keep content readable without JavaScript, media opt-in, motion responsive to the OS preference, and factual claims supported by `docs/content-sources.md`.

Do not recreate the old splash, in-memory navigation, global animation loops or effect/settings framework. A single stylesheet owns the responsive design. Use the owner's configured Antigravity CLI (`agy`) for small delegated tasks where useful, without bypassing permissions.
